symptom: a near body that stops being current (cooled, logged off, dead) during the native improvement write returns before the end-of-step raise, uncounted; the cold row may then run the same improvement again (refused write, rarely a second paid draw)
owner: BotImprovementService.reviewHot commit path (end of a held improvement step)

cause.explanation: reviewHot's .then starts with `if (!current()) return result;` (src/GameServer/Bot/Economy/BotImprovementService.js:139 at 6c1455b5e), before stepDone; when the body is no longer current the committed improvement raises nothing and the held step survives in the cold row. Pre-existing since d4322a214; DT-200a added the raise on every other success path
evidence: git log -S: line present since d4322a214

nonGoals: refreshing the gone body's backpack or stats
acceptance: a committed improvement whose body stopped being current during the write still ends its held step once (raiseOn on the row), counted as the other raises are
no double raise when the body is current
